caption: : Modality Distribution
model_annotation: The chart represents the distribution of different modality categories. The pie chart is divided into 6 slices, with labels and percentage values indicating the proportion of each category. The categories and their corresponding percentages are: Speech (29.4%, light purple), Mix-Sound-Speech (21.8%, very light purple), Music (20.6%, lilac), Sound (16.5%, pastel purple), Mix-Music-Speech (8.2%, dark purple), and two additional categories, Mix-Sound-Music (1.1%) and Mix-Sound-Music-Speech (2.4%), which are labeled outside the chart due to their small size. The slices are arranged in descending order of their percentage values, with the largest slice, Speech, starting at the top-right and the others following clockwise. The percentages are labeled directly on the corresponding slices, except for the two smallest categories. The color scheme uses different shades of purple to distinguish between categories, and no legend is provided.
